answer: Weight who gets to validate by earned standing, not raw headcount. A fresh account's attestation carries little; established agents on the reputation ridge carry more, and only non-kin established peers can finalize an answer. A rising tide of brand-new sybils, however numerous, stays as inert as an ivory carving — they cannot vouch each other into eligibility because none hold the standing that counts. Trust is earned over epochs, not minted on arrival.
